name: Best Things To Do In Paris
summary: A travel guide showcasing the best things to do in Paris, from iconic landmarks like the Eiffel Tower and Louvre to museums, neighborhoods and food, ahead of the Paris 2024 Olympics.

places.name: Eiffel Tower
tips: Start with the Eiffel Tower as an essential must-visit in Paris
It is an iconic symbol of Parisian elegance
You can admire the tower from below
You can ascend to the top for breathtaking views of the city

places.name: Louvre Museum
tips: Enter through the iconic glass pyramid
Described as a treasure trove of artistic masterpieces
Explore long galleries lined with paintings
See sculpture halls with statues
See the Mona Lisa
Expect large crowds around the Mona Lisa
Visitors use audio guides and take photos
Check links in the description below for booking

places.name: Notre Dame
tips: Features stunning Gothic architecture
Has a large central rose window on the facade
Busy public plaza in front with many visitors

places.name: Seine River
tips: The Seine River winds gracefully through Paris
Take a sightseeing boat cruise on the river
Enjoy views of the Eiffel Tower from the water

places.name: Sacre Coeur
tips: Perched atop Montmartre
White basilica with large central dome and smaller domes
Offers panoramic views over Paris from hilltop
Wide steps and grassy area in front where visitors gather and relax

places.name: Montmartre
tips: Sacre Coeur is perched atop Montmartre
Climb the steps of the basilica for panoramic views of Paris
Admire its gleaming white domes and striking architecture
You can go inside the basilica to see intricate mosaics and statues

places.name: Musee d'Orsay
tips: Houses a collection of 19th and early 20th-century art
The historic building features a large exterior clock
Interior has a large ornate clock window under a vaulted glass roof

places.name: Champs-Élysées
tips: Champs-Élysées & Arc de Triomphe are an iconic duo in Paris
Walk the wide tree-lined avenue with shops and crowds of pedestrians
Admire the Arc de Triomphe's detailed sculptures and carved archway
Go up to the rooftop terrace for panoramic views over the city
See the Arc de Triomphe illuminated at night

places.name: Arc de Triomphe
tips: Champs-Élysées & Arc de Triomphe are an iconic duo in Paris
Stroll the Champs-Élysées, a famous avenue lined with shops and restaurants
Walk the busy pedestrian street toward the Arc de Triomphe
Admire the detailed sculptures and carvings on the Arc
Go up to the rooftop terrace for panoramic views over Paris
See the Arc de Triomphe illuminated at night

places.name: Sainte-Chapelle
tips: A stunning example of Gothic architecture

places.name: Palace of Versailles
tips: A breathtaking symbol of royal opulence
See the grand palace exterior with golden gates
See the opulent interior hall with chandeliers and paintings
Explore the vast formal gardens with fountains and statues

places.name: Moulin Rouge
tips: Described on screen as a legendary cabaret
Recognizable by its iconic red windmill on the roof
Features bright illuminated neon signage including BAL DU MOULIN ROUGE and Féerie
Best seen lit up at night

places.name: Père Lachaise Cemetery
tips: Final resting place for many famous individuals
Tomb of Honoré de Balzac

places.name: Paris Catacombs
tips: A haunting glimpse into the city's history
View underground walls lined with skulls and bones

places.name: Disneyland Paris
tips: A magical destination where fairy tales come to life
Stroll through Main Street with its colorful shops and buildings
See the Sleeping Beauty Castle at the center of the park
Enjoy family rides in Fantasyland like the carousel
Ride Le Carrousel de Lancelot
Ride Dumbo the Flying Elephant ride

places.name: Le Marais
tips: Le Marais is a vibrant neighborhood
Explore streets lined with shops and boutiques
Walk through historic stone-arched arcades
Relax at outdoor cafes along narrow cobblestone lanes

places.name: Food Markets
tips: Food markets offer a delightful array of fresh produce
Browse stalls with watermelon, bananas, oranges and other fresh fruits and vegetables
Try hot prepared food like sausages served from large pans

places.name: Musée de l'Orangerie
tips: Showcases Claude Monet's Water Lilies series

places.name: Picasso Museum
tips: Celebrates the artistic genius of Pablo Picasso
Displays Picasso paintings and artworks
